name: garage-functions
description: Cloud Functions do Garage Power Lab

scripts.checar: tsc && node lib/checar.js && node lib/checar-conquistas.js && node lib/checar-box.js && node lib/checar-hiit.js && node lib/checar-cross.js && node lib/checar-pix.js && node lib/checar-pix-http.js
